headline: serendipity
subtitle: /ˌser.ənˈdɪp.ə.ti/
body_en: Finding something good without looking for it.
body_ru: Счастливая случайность: найти хорошее, не ища его.
example: Meeting her in that tiny bookshop was pure serendipity.

headline: resilient
subtitle: /rɪˈzɪl.i.ənt/
body_en: Able to recover quickly after something difficult.
example: The service stayed resilient during the outage.

headline: glance
subtitle: /ɡlɑːns/
body_en: A quick look, just enough to understand.
body_ru: Быстрый взгляд, которого хватает, чтобы понять.
example: A good widget tells you everything at a glance.

headline: tidy
subtitle: /ˈtaɪ.di/
example: Keep your desktop tidy and your widgets few.

headline: nudge
subtitle: /nʌdʒ/
body_en: A gentle push toward doing something.
example: The streak counter is a daily nudge to practice.

headline: wayfinding
subtitle: /ˈweɪˌfaɪn.dɪŋ/
body_en: How people figure out where they are and where to go.
body_ru: То, как люди понимают, где они и куда идти.
example: Clear headers are wayfinding for your eyes.

headline: cadence
subtitle: /ˈkeɪ.dəns/
body_en: The regular rhythm of something that repeats.
example: A fifteen-minute cadence keeps the widget fresh.

headline: frugal
subtitle: /ˈfruː.ɡəl/
example: Widgets must be frugal with their reload budget.
